title: Walking in parades and carrying a Mardi Gras parade alone
summary: Punch says fingering made him misstep with the drum and tells of playing a whole parade when the other trumpeter failed to show.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: What about when they're walking? Did you walk any special way?

And by me doing a lot of fingering, I'd misstep with the, you know, like, with the drum, you know. Boom, boom. It's important to walk right with the drum, you know. But now when they're playing in the funeral march, I used to walk right direct. I took a parade, y'all, one mardiogram for the buzzards. And the trumpet player was to show up and they didn't.
